conventions.cells: one character per cell = a role index (see legend); never a colour
conventions.light_direction: top-left: frame_hi / pale tones on the top and left rings, frame_lo / dark tones bottom and right
conventions.slopes: rise:run, perfect slopes only (1:1 corner nicks; 2:1 hexagon sides)

scale_model.unit: 1 template cell = 1 art pixel; S = art-pixel size in device px, S in {1, 2}
scale_model.border_width_px: slice x S, listed per template under 1x and 2x in CSS order [top, right, bottom, left]; derived from the slices, never typed twice
scale_model.fractional: at any device pixel ratio other than a whole number a Qt border-image is smooth-scaled; frames are generated at S x DPR and crisp only at whole ratios

conventions.nine_slice: slices are {left, top, right, bottom}; corners unchanged, edges and centre repeat (border-image mode `repeat repeat`)

title_plate.rows: 3 ring rows + 16 title rows (one template row, repeated) + 1 seam row; the 14 px text line fits inside the 16 title rows

conventions.corners: docked child frames (dock, panel, buttons) may carry a 1-2 px corner treatment whose notch shows the parent's background role; popups, dialogs, fields and sub-controls are square (no translucent backing)
conventions.floating_docks: native OS chrome, no Qt frame; a custom title-bar widget is the only alternative

focus.mechanism: outline overlay: an app-level filter attaches a transparent child widget on focus-in (hides on focus-out) that paints the focus_ring 9-slice; there is no `*:focus` rule and no *_focus template
focus.covers: ring 0 + ring 1 of the target frame (button 4 rings, field 3 rings)
focus.clearance: a widget's own sub-controls keep at least 2 px between the ring and themselves
focus.focus_rings: maps each focusable framed-control template to the ring template painted over it; the roles the ring touches are derived from this art and become gated focus pairs

conventions.selected_state: accent fill + a 1 px accent_text cue ring at ring depth 3 (a non-colour cue); check boxes carry a check mark instead
conventions.state_precedence: declaration order: normal, :hover, :checked, :pressed (pressed > checked > hover > normal); disabled = text role disabled_text on the normal template; checked + hover shows checked
conventions.ornaments: overlay sprites: docks = bottom corners only, dialogs = four corners; the ornament template is the top-left master, flipped for the other corners; clear zone at each corner: no text within ornament size minus ring of the corner; inset = 0
conventions.dialog: native OS title bar kept; the dialog frame has no title band; an optional heading row (template `heading`) between the two top ornaments only where a dialog has a heading
conventions.tabs: tabs are closed buttons (button_normal / button_checked) with a 3 px gap above the pane: no open-bottom template and no flipped variant
conventions.pattern_rule: pattern ink only inside the enumerated empty containers (pattern_surfaces); never on canvas_workspace, never on a list viewport; drawn by a clipped paint routine, not by a stylesheet background-image

pattern_surfaces.why: QToolBar tail is empty space below the last control; a dedicated PatternArea widget is added as the toolbar's last item
the strip right of the transport controls is empty space inside the Timeline dock; PatternArea as a stretch item

dock_title.note: QDockWidget::title: assembled height = line 14 + 2 x ring = 20 rows; the T row repeats; seam row last

dock_body.qss_hint: QFrame#DockBody { border-image; border-width: 0 3px 3px 3px } (child of the dock content; QFrame insets its contents)
dock_body.note: QFrame#DockBody under the title plate; no top ring (the plate carries it)

panel.qss_hint: QToolBar, QTabWidget::pane (and a floating dock with a custom title widget)
panel.note: uniform frame: toolbar, tab pane, floating dock with a custom title widget

dialog.note: QDialog: SQUARE corners (top-level window, no translucent backing); no title band, the native title bar stays

heading.qss_hint: QLabel#dialogHeading (only in dialogs that have a heading)
heading.note: optional in-dialog heading row (QLabel#dialogHeading), ONLY in dialogs that have a heading

ornament.note: overlay sprite, top-left master; flip h/v for the other corners; roles ornament + ornament_outline

button_normal.note: QPushButton / QToolButton / QTabBar::tab (tabs are closed buttons: no open-bottom variant, no :bottom flip)

button_checked.note: :checked - accent fill + 1 px accent_text cue ring inside the fill (a non-colour cue)

menu.note: QMenu and QComboBox popup: SQUARE corners

tooltip.qss_hint: QToolTip (also set its background-color by role)
tooltip.note: QToolTip: SQUARE corners; QToolTip needs a role background (Qt's own default is an unthemed light grey)

scroll_handle.note: QScrollBar::handle (vertical); horizontal = transpose; arrow buttons are not drawn (::add-line / ::sub-line height 0)

slider_groove.note: QSlider::groove (horizontal); ::sub-page is a QSS background in role accent

check_on.note: QCheckBox::indicator:checked: accent fill + accent_text check mark (the mark is the non-colour cue)

focus_ring.qss_hint: overlay child widget (no :focus rule); silhouette of buttons and tool buttons
focus_ring.note: OVERLAY (child widget painted on FocusIn, hidden on FocusOut): 2 art px ring over ring 0 + ring 1 of buttons, tabs, tool buttons

focus_ring_square.qss_hint: overlay child widget (no :focus rule); fields, lists, trees, sliders, check boxes
focus_ring_square.note: OVERLAY for fields, lists, trees, combos: 2 art px ring over the 1-3 px border (square silhouette)
